This module implements a high-performance, thread-safe Least Recently Used (LRU) cache
with Time-To-Live (TTL) expiration support. It is designed for concurrent environments
and includes comprehensive error handling, metrics tracking, and a complete test suite.

Key Features:
1. LRU Eviction Policy: Automatically removes the least recently accessed items when
   the cache reaches its maximum size.
2. TTL Expiry: Items expire after a configurable number of seconds. Expired items are
   lazily removed upon access and eagerly removed during cleanup cycles.
3. Thread Safety: Uses fine-grained locking to ensure safe concurrent access without
   global bottlenecks.
4. Metrics: Tracks hits, misses, evictions, and expirations for monitoring.
5. Callbacks: Supports custom callbacks on cache hits, misses, and evictions.
6. Async Support: Optional async interface for use in asynchronous applications.
